answer: Ask what the applicant paid before anyone offered a reward. Proof of vehicle ownership via registration plate transfer ledger is paid in advance, years early: a transfer the registry recorded when the plate changed hands. The bridge of the payment is its timing - it predates this epoch, this project, this prize. Forging a hundred such payments means moving a hundred sums backward in time, and the nectar of each is the bank's own ledger, which the applicant cannot edit. The sparrow the gate checks is the ledger's date line, matched against the claim.
